text: moira rang, knee op is finally booked for nov 12 at st james, in for 2 nights then 6 wks on crutches. her husband Patrick can't get time off so her sister is coming down from glasgow to help. she sounded ok but i think she's more nervous than she's letting on. text her the day after to see how she's doing and maybe drop a meal round the wk after

elif's retirement do is fri 28/11 at the rugby club, 7ish. 34 yrs at the council!! her son Archie is doing a speech and apparently there's a slideshow, she's mortified. need to sort a card b4 then and get everyone in the office to sign it, maybe a voucher for that garden centre she loves

dinner at sunil and meera's tmrw 7pm. i'm doing dessert

oscar leaving drinks thurs, he's off to a startup in leeds. dont forget to chip in for the gift

aiko nervous abt her first day at the hospital mon. new job as a ward sister. text her good luck sun night

appt w/ dentist 4th nov 9.15, then pick up prescription

mustafa back at work after his heart op, doing half days for now. looked well tbh

asha's party cancelled, her dad's in hospital again. check in w/ her tmrw
valentina and patrick having a joint 30th on 22nd november, at theirs. i'm bringing the speaker

ines starts her phd in feb, moving to edinburgh for it. her brother Karim is helping w/ the move

patrick from work — paddy — just got the regional manager job. send congrats
pick up dry cleaning, book car in for MOT b4 the 30th
tobi's wife Elif is due in march!! they told us at dinner last night

bumped into lwazi at the station. says the new role at the uni is way more admin than he thought and his manager is micromanaging everything. he's not loving it, thinking of giving it til christmas then looking again. also his partner Ines got the promotion she was after, starts as team lead on 1st of jan so at least one of them is happy he said
had lunch w/ Sunil today. he's training for a half marathon in april, did 15k sat. vegan now too

björn's wife has her gallbladder op on 9 jan, been waiting nearly a yr. he's taking 2 wks off to look after the kids which his boss wasn't thrilled abt, esp w/ him only just starting as head of ops on the 5th. bad timing all round. i said we'd have the kids one evening that wk
remember aiko's farewell lunch 2pm fri 7th nov, her last day at the clinic after 12 yrs. get flowers
luis 'lou' gupta invited us to their christening, baby Mateo, sun 30 nov 11am at st marks
oscar's new job in leeds started 10/1, he says the commute's killing him already. text him next wk to see if its getting any better
siobhan had her biopsy results back thurs, benign. massive relief
jorge's retiring party on June 3rd next yr, his daughter is organising, wants us to keep it free. she said he'd love a new set of golf irons

hamza's dad passed away sun after a long time in the hospice. funeral is 31st oct at 1pm, wake after at his uncle's. hamza seems numb more than anything, zofia says he's not sleeping. need to send a card and ask if they need anything, and check whether work will let me go to the funeral
zofia's book club is the 2nd weds of every month now, she wants me to join
Dr Tanaka said results back in 2 wks, follow up appt 25 nov
dinner w/ mustafa and his wife Asha sat. they've just booked their honeymoon for may 14 — maldives!

ask kieran how the bank interview went, and whether they said when he'd hear
karim's housewarming 29/11 but im away that wknd. send him a plant or something
rin loves anything matcha, good shout for xmas or her bday

ricardo's mum is in hospital w/ pneumonia since tues. he's going up to see her this wknd. message him mon
marcus is a chef at that new place on king st. said he'd get us a table

tobi said his boss is leaving in the spring and he might go for the role. hasn't told anyone yet

sunil starting at deloitte on 5/12 but gotta work notice til 4/30 at current place. celebration drinks once he's settled, he says may sometime. note to self: he's off dairy now
called karim re the plumbing, he's back from hospital after his appendix, out since sat. says the scar is huge

the leaving lunch for jorge got moved from 12/5 to 12/12 cos half the team are off. he's been at the depot 22 yrs so it's a big one. i'm collecting for the gift, so far £85. he likes fishing and whisky so maybe a nice bottle and a hip flask engraved. need to remind people to pay by the 8th
need to rsvp to amir's dinner by fri and buy a new shirt
